subject: Proposal: Annual commit restructure & soft overage buffer for NebulaHealth
messages:
From: Alex Singh <alex.singh@nebulahc.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Park <sam.park@nebulahc.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: capacity increase & overage protection

Marcus —

Quick note as we start our renewal planning: NebulaHealth is projecting a 2.5x increase in inference usage over the next 12 months (driven by voice transcription and expanded patient triage flows). We think a higher committed monthly throughput makes sense, but we need: 
- predictable unit rates as we upsize the commit
- a soft overage buffer (small % over commit charged at capped rate) for bursty nights
- clarity on per-route rate limits and throttling behavior so our infra team can plan fallbacks

I attached our Q1 usage summary. Can Redwood propose a commit range (monthly tokens) + proposed ratebands and what the overage cushion would look like? Also: are there any SLA or latency differences if we move to a higher tier?

Happy to set a call this week.

Thanks,
Alex Singh
Director of Platform
NebulaHealth

Attachment: nebulahc_q1_usage_summary.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Singh <alex.singh@nebulahc.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity increase & overage protection

Alex —

Thanks for the context and the usage file. We can absolutely put together a couple of structured options:

1) Stepped annual commit — 1.5x / 2.5x / 3x commit tiers with volume discounts and a 5% soft overage buffer charged at a capped mid-tier rate.
2) Fixed higher commit with a staged escalation (monthly checkpoints) and a burst pocket for short-term spikes (up to 10% for <72 hours) with pre-agreed contingency credits.

Latency/SLA: higher committed tiers get priority routing and a tighter latency SLO for hosted API routes (we can commit to p95 token latency guardrails in the contract).

I looped in Vanessa (CS lead) and Kimberly (Account Executive) to coordinate pricing + legal redline for an amendment. Can you do a short demo of your projected traffic shape on Thursday at 10am PT? If so, we’ll prep specific numbers and a DocuSign-ready amendment.

Best,
Marcus
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

--

Team — forwarding NebulaHealth's ask and their Q1 usage. Key asks: commit uplift, capped overage buffer, clear per-route throttling.

Notes / asks for pricing:
- Please model a 12-month stepped commit ladder (base commit = current monthly, step1=1.5x, step2=2.5x) and show blended per-token economics.
- Include an option for a 5% soft buffer at a capped rate, and a separate short-duration burst pocket (10% for up to 72 hours) with contingency credits.
- Confirm latency SLO change if they accept priority routing (what's p95 delta vs current?).
- Legal: can we pre-author a DocuSign amendment with a mutual action plan for checkpoints at months 1, 3, 6?

Link to our draft folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleProposal
Attachments to produce: RDW-4567_proposed_amendment_draft.docx (pricing + MAP)

Can you have a first-pass pricing matrix by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks — Marcus

> P.S. Vanessa — if you can own onboarding ops (warm-up plan + KV cache priming), call that out in the MAP.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: capacity increase & overage protection

All — first pass attached (RDW-4567_proposed_amendment_draft.docx). High level pricing options included in the doc; summary here: 

- Option A (Conservative): 1.5x monthly commit, 10% volume discount on marginal rate, 5% soft overage buffer at capped mid-tier rate. Estimated annual spend: $1.2M.
- Option B (Growth): 2.5x monthly commit, 18% discount, 5% soft overage + 10% burst pocket for short spikes (charged as pre-purchase credit that rolls over monthly). Estimated annual spend: $1.9M.
- Option C (Aggressive): fixed 3x commit, 24% discount, no overage (overage absorbed into rate), premium routing & extended SLA. Estimated annual spend: $2.4M.

Legal notes: I added MAP checkpoints (30/90/180 days) and a clause for capped overage billing rates; counsel asked we avoid language that guarantees absolute latency; we can guarantee routing prioritization and p95 targets with credits for SLO misses.

Next steps: Marcus — once you confirm preferred option with Alex on the call, I’ll finalize the amendment and push to DocuSign.

Attachment: RDW-4567_proposed_amendment_draft.docx (DOCX, 68 KB)

-Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
